analytics.name: Analytic 1667
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Dynamic Resolution by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: InetAddress.getByName() or DnsResolver called > $DGACandidateThreshold$ times with algorithmically-distinct hostnames in $DGAWindow$ — rapid programmatic resolution attempts]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 20 per device per app within window. Tightening: 10. Derive from per-app DNS baseline.
Default 30s between last NXDOMAIN and successful resolution.
Per-app known CDN/update domains from 30-day baseline.
Default 10 distinct hostname queries within window.
